title: Distribution of values of bounded generalized polynomials
relevant_concepts: generalized polynomials generated by ordinary polynomials plus floor
nilmanifold representation of bounded GP mappings
notes: Acta Math. 198 (2007), 155-230. A generalized polynomial is built from ordinary polynomials by +, *, and integer part. The distributional theory is a nilmanifold calculus for that class. n^{3/2} is not a polynomial, so floor(n^{3/2})^{9/4} is not a GP and the Heisenberg packaging of the leftover is not a BL representation. Cited by docs/problems/juggler_rate_free_floor_hardy.md and Paper B §2.
